summary.overview: During the Business Development meeting between Faheem and Andy, key discussions focused on enhancing outreach strategies and refining investment approaches. Faheem shared insights on the local versus tourist experiences in Las Vegas, revealing his recent shift from software engineering to private investing. He detailed his investment thesis, emphasizing the growth of small businesses and technology integration, with a goal to elevate them to the lower middle market for private equity exits. However, challenges in reaching suitable business personas were highlighted, as many contacts sought investment rather than selling opportunities. Target industries of interest were specified, including manufacturing, healthcare, and education, while a need for improved filtering of outreach contacts was recognized due to low engagement in recent campaigns. To address these issues, Faheem proposed pivoting his strategy towards a consulting-for-equity model, leveraging his tech expertise as a fractional CTO, positioning himself better to meet small business needs. Action items were assigned to Andy to continue refining the outreach strategy and to Faheem to implement his new strategic direction.
